remarks: Welcome to 99 Prospect Street at Prospect Grove Condominiums, one of Stamford's most popular and affordable residential communities, ideal for both owner-occupants and investors. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Downtown Stamford, this prime location offers easy access to dining, shopping, transportation, Stamford train station, and all the conveniences of city living. The building is well maintained with attractive common areas, and the HOA includes heat, hot water, and cooking gas, plus the added benefit of an assigned parking space (#154). This roughly 600 sq ft has a generously sized bedroom with built-in closet space, and a full bathroom. Stay comfortable year-round with two wall A/C units for the summer months and enjoy the convenience of a clean common laundry room on site. A great opportunity to own or invest in a popular building right in the heart of downtown Stamford
